description: Every conversation people started with the business's own accounts, as People's inbox shows it: comments under its posts and ads, mentions, reviews, direct messages and message requests. Each with who it is from, every message's own words and when, the post a comment is under (its words, address and picture), where it stands (new, drafted, answered by Marsell or by the owner in the platform's own app, yours: the owner's to answer, skipped: the owner chose not to answer it, until they write again, or history: from before the account was connected, or more than two weeks old when Marsell first read it, never answered), the ad or link that brought them when one did, what Marsell read it as, and Marsell's drafted reply. how_it_answers: the last 30 days, counted from these same conversations: the messages that came in and from how many people, how many were answered, the middle and slowest waits for an answer in seconds, and the conversations counted. conversation: one by its id. Reads only.

conversation.description: One conversation, by its id. Every one when left out.
